subject.title: Plugin `message_sending` hooks silently bypassed on channel agent-reply delivery paths (2026.5.26, still present in 2026.6.1)

question: Which open fix branch should be the canonical repair for this issue's dispatcher and Telegram streamed-final `message_sending` bypass?
rationale: The bug is real, but the remaining choice is a safety-hook ownership boundary: narrower dispatcher-only branches do not cover streamed finals, while the broad branch needs repair and maintainer acceptance of the exactly-once design.

options.title: Select Comprehensive Branch After Repair
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93216 as the canonical path if its draft/conflict state, suffix duplicate-hook finding, and proof gaps are resolved.

options.title: Land Narrow Dispatcher Fix First
options.body: Use a smaller dispatcher-only PR such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92976 for the shared configured-branch bypass while keeping streamed-final coverage tracked separately.

options.title: Ask For Replacement Branch
options.body: Close or supersede the current candidates only after a narrower maintainer-owned branch covers both required paths without the existing readiness blockers.

recommendation.title: Select Comprehensive Branch After Repair
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93216 as the canonical path if its draft/conflict state, suffix duplicate-hook finding, and proof gaps are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the broad active branch that attempts the full dispatcher plus Telegram streamed-final repair and are mentioned in the latest issue update as the active branch maintainer.
